inputs.high_level_description: An authentic, in-universe Abyssal manuscript scroll drawn on ancient, weathered parchment by Lyza the Unreaped. The page presents a meticulous hand-drawn ink blueprint and field study of Reg's iconic helmet (empty) resting on a stone ledge alongside the Star Compass relic. The entire document is covered in handwritten field notes, measurement lines, and archaic Abyssal runic script, rendered using dip-pen line art, crosshatching, and varied colored inks.
inputs.background: A heavily aged, brittle parchment paper scroll with burnt brown edges, organic ink smudges, subtle water stains, and vertical fold lines, giving the feel of a centuries-old Abyssal document.
inputs.style.art_style: Hand-drawn dark fantasy field journal illustration, fine-nib dip pen crosshatching, colored ink washes, handwritten calligraphy, weathered antique manuscript texture.
inputs.aesthetics: A raw, atmospheric in-universe field-notes manuscript featuring fine-nib ink line art, heavy crosshatching, variable ink bleed, coffee ring stains, and worn parchment creases. Blends precise relic schematic drawings with expressive explorer journal notes.
inputs.lighting: Flat overhead lighting illuminating the organic texture of yellowed paper grain, brittle burnt scroll edges, and subtle ink transparency.
